title: fleet.external.v1
description: The fleet's own hand-maintained registry of work that a task's 'needs' can point to without that work having its own file in fleet/tasks/ -- historical work that predates the fleet, or work tracked elsewhere entirely. A need is valid only if it resolves to a fleet/tasks/ id or a key here (fleet.py validate); whether it is actually SATISFIED is decided by this file's own 'state', hand-edited by a human as real-world work lands -- never inferred from a need's own claim (fleet.py plan).

repo.description: Which repo this external work landed (or will land) in. Used to scope fleet.py plan's path-overlap check against fleet tasks in the same repo.

state.description: The only field a human edits to mark this satisfied. 'open' = still outstanding (needs pointing at it stay blocked; if 'paths' is set, fleet.py plan checks it for overlap against fleet tasks). 'merged' = landed; needs pointing at it are satisfied.

branch.description: Branch name, if known and still relevant (null once merged and deleted, or if never tracked).

paths.description: Globs, relative to 'repo', that this external item touches or claims while 'state' is 'open'. fleet.py plan flags any fleet task in the same repo whose allowed_paths overlaps one of these -- the two could collide if run concurrently. Safety (relative, no '..', no absolute) is enforced the same way as task allowed_paths, by fleet.py's check_path_safety.

note.description: Free-text context for a human reading this file. Never parsed.
